title: Sort and Merge Intervals
summary: Sort ranges by a boundary so overlap with the next range can be decided locally against one current merged frontier.
recognition_signals: input consists of ranges or intervals
overlapping ranges should be consolidated into their union
core_rules: Sort before relying on a local frontier comparison.
Use the interval endpoint semantics from the problem contract when deciding whether touching ranges overlap.
structural_steps: for each next interval, test overlap with the frontier
extend the frontier on overlap or emit it and start a new frontier

common_confusions.distinction: Merging intervals combines overlapping coverage into unions. Greedy interval selection intentionally chooses a subset of intervals to optimize an objective; the goals are different.
